content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To treat panic attacks, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Conduct an initial intake interview with a therapist (1 hour)
Step 2. Research local support groups (2 hours)
Step 3. Enroll in an intensive 8-week Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction course (8 weeks)
Step 4. Attend a support group orientation session (90 minutes)
Step 5. Complete a monthly progress self-assessment (30 minutes)
Step 6. Schedule a comprehensive physical exam with a GP (3 days)
Step 7. Finalize a long-term wellness maintenance plan (2 hours)
Step 8. Undergo blood work to rule out thyroid issues (1 day)
Step 9. Participate in a group therapy breakout session (1 hour)
Step 10. Review physiological triggers with a specialist (45 minutes)
Step 11. Practice progressive muscle relaxation techniques (20 minutes)
Step 12. Begin a daily mood tracking journal (1 week)
Step 13. Purchase recommended books on cognitive behavioral therapy (1 hour)
Step 14. Download a medically-reviewed mental health app (10 minutes)
Step 15. Create a "calm down kit" with sensory items (30 minutes)
Step 16. Identify primary environmental stressors (2 hours)
Step 17. Implement a consistent sleep hygiene routine (2 weeks)
Step 18. Listen to an educational podcast on anxiety neuroscience (45 minutes)
Step 19. Analyze mood journal data for recurring patterns (3 hours)
Step 20. Attend a follow-up consultation with a psychiatrist (45 minutes)
Step 21. Learn basic diaphragmatic breathing exercises (30 minutes)
Step 22. Discuss caffeine and stimulant reduction with a nutritionist (1 hour)
Step 23. Schedule a physical fitness assessment (1 hour)
Step 24. Read the first half of a CBT workbook (4 hours)
Step 25. Complete the practical exercises in the CBT workbook (5 hours)
Step 26. Obtain a formal referral for psychological services (2 days)
Step 27. Undergo a standardized psychological diagnostic screening (3 hours)
Step 28. Consult with a pharmacist regarding potential medication (30 minutes)
Step 29. Practice "grounding" techniques during a simulated high-stress moment (15 minutes)
Step 30. Search for reputable online mental health resources (3 hours)
Step 31. Develop a personalized "panic emergency" action plan (2 hours)
Step 32. Practice deep breathing during a minor stressful event (10 minutes)
Step 33. Set up a dedicated meditation space at home (1 hour)
Step 34. Join an online community for anxiety management (30 minutes)
Step 35. Watch a video series on exposure therapy (4 hours)
Step 36. Record a guided meditation for personal use (15 minutes)
Step 37. Apply for a medical leave of absence or workplace accommodations (1 week)
Step 38. Draft a list of personal affirmations (20 minutes)
Step 39. Schedule an appointment with a massage therapist for tension release (2 days)
Step 40. Attend a workshop on emotional regulation (6 hours)
Step 41. Buy a high-quality yoga mat and blocks (15 minutes)
Step 42. Set up recurring calendar alerts for medication or therapy (10 minutes)
Step 43. Begin a 30-day trial of a new morning routine (30 days)
Step 44. Gather insurance coverage information for mental health (1 hour)
Step 45. Join a local recreational sports team for stress relief (3 days)
Step 46. Visit a quiet nature park to practice mindfulness (2 hours)
Step 47. Buy a dedicated notebook for therapy notes (15 minutes)
Step 48. Review the results of the 30-day routine trial (1 hour)
Step 49. Establish a "safe person" contact list (15 minutes)
Step 50. File a summary of symptoms for medical records (30 minutes)
